description:
In the rural village of Hwangryongchon, Poi Jong tends to his farm and hones the blade of the volcanic sword. Coincidentally, the volcanic sect of Mount Hua is organizing a martial arts competition known as the Volcanic Gao Dragon Tournament, featuring the disciples of the sect. 

Poi Jong decides to join the tournament, and accompanied by his son, they embark on the journey towards the volcano sect. However, he finds himself entangled in the martial arts world, leading to a series of unexpected events. 

Will Poi Jong be able to reach Mount Hua? What level of mastery will Poi Jong achieve with his sword along this journey? This is the journey of Poi Jong to test the sword he has raised in the village. 

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
